description: 30 questions over the real IIT Jodhpur corpus (data1/chroma, 33 documents) and the structured CSVs (data1/structured). Reference answers were read from the source documents; schedule and email answers were derived from the CSVs by code. Fields: must_contain entries are AND-ed; a list entry means any one of its options; groundedness_doc_ids is any-of.

questions.question: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?
questions.reference_answer: Under the July 2024 amendment, exam performance is no longer linked to attendance. A student is expected to have full attendance, but attendance must not fall below 75% in a course; below that, the instructor can recommend de-registration. Failing the 75% criterion no longer bars a student from the exam or forces a minimum C grade.

questions.question: How many examinations are held in a semester and how long is the Major exam?
questions.reference_answer: One Minor (a 2-hour written exam around mid-semester) and one Major (a 3-hour written exam at the end, covering the whole syllabus, with weightage not less than 40%).

questions.question: By when must I apply for a make-up exam if I miss the Major exam because of illness?
questions.reference_answer: Apply to the Dean (Academics) through the course instructor within ten days from the date of the missed examination, explaining the reasons. Late applications need not be entertained. Permission is given under exceptional circumstances such as hospital admission, with the required document.

questions.question: Until when can I withdraw from a course, and how does it appear on my grade card?
questions.reference_answer: After the last date of add-drop a student may withdraw from a course; the last date for withdrawal is typically within four weeks of the start of the semester as per the academic calendar. A withdrawn course appears with the letter grade W.

questions.question: What is the last date to add or drop courses in Semester I of 2026-27?
questions.reference_answer: 7 August 2026 (Friday), which is also the late-registration date.

questions.question: When is the Minor examination in Semester I of 2026-27?
questions.reference_answer: 15-20 September 2026.

questions.question: How many credits is one hour of lab per week worth, compared with one hour of lecture?
questions.reference_answer: One lecture hour per week is 1 credit; one lab (or project) hour per week is 0.5 credit. Credits are total hours (contact plus beyond-contact) divided by 3.

questions.question: When is an undergraduate student placed on academic probation?
questions.reference_answer: From the third semester onward, a student who fails to earn a minimum of 12 credits in a registered semester is placed on academic probation. Two consecutive semesters on probation lead to termination of registration.

questions.question: How can I convert my CGPA into a percentage?
questions.reference_answer: The Institute awards no class or division and has no uniformly accepted formula, but notionally the CGPA may be multiplied by 10 to obtain the percentage.

questions.question: What is the semester fee for a hosteller in Academic Year 2026-27?
questions.reference_answer: The semester fee is Rs 32,250 for a hosteller (Rs 20,000 for a day scholar), in addition to tuition fee as per Annexure-I.

questions.question: How many Open Elective credits do I need to earn in order to get a B.Tech. degree?
questions.reference_answer: The B.Tech. curricula in the corpus list Programme and Open Electives together (for example 6 + 15 credits in the last two semesters of B.Tech. CSE out of 150 graded credits) and do not state a separate Open Elective total. A correct answer says so; a refusal that logs the question is also acceptable. Inventing a single number is wrong.
